description: Beaverome, a bowl of shallow lakes and narrow sloping shores with almost no flat ground: the start shore holds the pits and small workshops, the only flat strip large enough for a 10x9 building (level 11, south-west shore) carries the Archive Excavation with the five Human Record Caches, and the map has no room for Deep Mines, Deep Drills, quarries or any building of 10x10 or more, so it supports only the early game.

unmet.reason: Every dry, flat 11x7 quarry footprint (52 candidates, levels 11-12) has trees or succulents on the 5x5 core where the seam must be placed, and a map placement cannot overlap natural objects; the level-0 corner lowlands are triangles too narrow for 11x7.

Every dry, flat 11x7 quarry footprint (52 candidates, levels 11-12) has trees or succulents on the 5x5 core where the seam must be placed, and a map placement cannot overlap natural objects; the level-0 corner lowlands are triangles too narrow for 11x7.

unmet.item: Deep Drill sites beside Deep Ore Sources
unmet.reason: Only 3 valid 11x9 Deep Drill footprints exist, all on the level-11 south-west strip; they overlap one another and every valid Archive Excavation footprint (exhaustive pair check), so not even one drill site can be listed beside the excavation, and two are impossible.

unmet.item: finite deep ore covers one of each building
unmet.reason: No Deep Ore Source is placed: a source is only useful beside a Deep Drill site, and no Deep Drill site fits (see the Deep Drill items: the only 11x9 drill footprints overlap the Archive Excavation strip), so the map has no finite deep ore.

unmet.item: renewable scrap (Underground Ruins for the Efficient Mine)
unmet.reason: Both Underground Ruins, at (117, 41, 3) and (149, 137, 0), lie on lake beds under 6.2 and 8.6 of water; no dry cell borders either of them.
